task.title: Add CONTRACTS.md and a wire-contract gate for the four egress surfaces
task.description: Aerofoil serialises one aircraft record to four surfaces: JSON-lines, gRPC/protobuf, MCP tool schemas, and (later) a TypeScript web client. SPEC 5 fixes the semantics and the framing rules but not the fields, so drift between a Rust struct and its TypeScript or protobuf counterpart would be caught by nothing until a consumer breaks. The gaugeblock suite solves this with a CONTRACTS.md plus miter contracts --check; aerofoil needs the document and the gate, but only once a second representation exists, because a gate with nothing to compare is a gate that passes for the wrong reason.
acceptance_criteria: docs/CONTRACTS.md exists with one section per surface, each field carrying name, type, optionality, units and schema version; wire types state their derives and any deliberate exception; SPEC 5 links to CONTRACTS.md rather than restating fields, so there is exactly one field-level source of truth; miter contracts --check joins Tier 3 only once the TypeScript client types exist, and the entry is added in the same commit as that client; protobuf compatibility is covered by a prost round-trip test or buf breaking check because miter contracts does not read .proto files; a breaking field change is a BREAKING CHANGE commit with a lockstep bump

task.title: Add the recording sink and a self-describing capture format
task.description: ROADMAP M3 requires a recorded capture to replay to identical JSON on two machines, and M4 requires end-to-end tests on recorded datasets, but nothing records a feed today. ADR-0009 fixes the seam: a RecordSink in a std-only aerofoil-persistence crate, with JSONL as implementation zero and no dependency beyond serde_json. The format has to be self-describing because the normal deployment is two bands from two dongles, so a recording must carry band, source and arrival time or a replay cannot reproduce what the tracker saw. The sink is a bounded drop-oldest subscriber with its own counters: recording must never backpressure the decoder.
acceptance_criteria: aerofoil-persistence exists as a std-only integrator crate exposing a RecordSink trait plus a JSONL implementation, with no dependency beyond serde_json; every recorded frame carries band, source and arrival time so a two-source capture replays into one tracker deterministically; the sink is bounded and drop-oldest with counters surfaced in telemetry, and a saturated sink leaves decoder throughput unchanged; a recorded capture replays to byte-identical JSON output on two machines; the crate name is reserved on crates.io and added to .gaugeblock/config.toml allowed_crates before any ticket is scoped to it; miter deps --layers classifies the crate as an integrator and no foundation crate depends on it

task.title: Fix MapLibre 3D DEM terrain black screen, CORS tile fallback, and layer rendering order
task.description: MapLibre 3D DEM renders a black/empty screen because AWS Terrarium S3 tiles lack CORS headers and hillshade layer blocks base tiles. Provide reliable CORS DEM source, graceful error fallback, and proper WebGL layer z-ordering.

task.title: Configure MapLibre GL v6 WebWorker URL for Vite and fix style-ready layer mounting
task.description: MapLibre GL v6 fails to load maplibre-gl-worker.mjs under Vite pre-bundling and production builds, causing a black 3D canvas. Configure setWorkerUrl with ?url asset import, strip {r} tile placeholders, and replace broken isStyleLoaded()/once('load') guards.

task.title: Load CARTO_API_KEY from .env with ?key= auth and verify 3D DEM relief rendering
task.description: Expose CARTO_API_KEY from .env in Vite, support CARTO Dark Matter and CARTO Voyager with ?key= parameter and visible carto.com/attributions, and ensure 3D DEM terrain mesh and hillshading visibly render in 3D mode.

task.title: Milestone 6: Advanced Surveillance Avionics, Clean-Room Parity & 3D Spatial Airspace
task.description: Epic covering clean-room functional parity with tar1090 (zero GPL code contamination) translated into native spatial 3D: aircraft telemetry inspector, callsign labels, multi-tracks, regex filtering, URL state persistence, extruded 3D airspaces, and chase camera tracking.

task.title: Glassmorphic Aircraft Inspector Pane with telemetry expansion and 3D altitude profile
task.description: Implement floating avionics inspector pane displaying hex, registration, airframe category, operator, squawk, TAS/IAS, Mach, roll angle, selected MCP altitude, RSSI, message rate, and dynamic 3D altitude profile sparkline.

task.title: LOD-aware aircraft callsign and altitude flight level map labels for 2D and 3D
task.description: Render collision-tested callsign/FL/speed text badges beside aircraft markers with zoom-level density decluttering in both 2D Leaflet and 3D MapLibre viewports.

task.title: Persistent multi-aircraft track trails and global track toggle hotkey (T)
task.description: Support hotkey T to toggle all aircraft flight trails, individual selection persistence, and multiselect inspection mode across 2D polylines and 3D flight ribbons.

task.title: Dynamic regex callsign search and spatial altitude/speed/provenance filtering
task.description: Interactive search bar supporting callsign regex (^UAL|DAL), altitude bounds slider (FL_min .. FL_max), speed boundaries, and data source toggle (adsb, uat, mlat).

task.title: Bidirectional URL search/hash state persistence for map position, mode, and target isolation
task.description: Deep-linking query parameters for map center, zoom, pitch, bearing, viewport mode, isolated ICAO hexes (?icao=...), and active filter criteria.

task.title: 3D extruded polygonal airspace volumes for Class B/C/D and Special Use Airspace
task.description: Render FAA Class B/C/D and Special Use Airspace (SUA) as semi-transparent 3D polygonal columns extruded from aeronautical floor to ceiling MSL in MapLibre GL.

task.title: Smooth 3D chase camera tracking and follow mode for active airborne targets
task.description: Smooth camera tracking locking behind selected aircraft along its kinematic velocity vector with interpolated pitch and heading tracking in 3D MapLibre mode.

task.title: Instanced 3D aircraft models with true pitch, roll, and heading orientation in MapLibre GL
task.description: Replace flat 2D icons in 3D mode with low-poly instanced 3D aircraft models (Commercial Jet, Heavy Transport, Regional Turboprop, Helicopter, Light GA) dynamically oriented in WebGL by heading, pitch, and roll angle.

task.title: Elevated 3D range rings and volumetric surveillance dome with floating altitude labels
task.description: Render elevated 3D range rings and hemispherical surveillance dome tiers (e.g., FL100, FL200, FL300) with floating nautical mile and flight level labels at radial intersections using MapLibre 3D symbol elevation.

task.title: Comprehensive End-to-End Test Suite, Kinematic Airspace Simulation & Live Capture Pipeline
task.description: Parent epic for comprehensive end-to-end verification: high-fidelity 50+ aircraft kinematic airspace generator, long-run flight kinematic trajectory tests, live network/Beast capture, full-stack SSE/WebSocket streaming tests, headless browser Playwright E2E automation, and RTL-SDR hardware DSP/IQ capture.

task.title: High-fidelity kinematic airspace trajectory synthesizer and realistic terminal hub fixture
task.description: Expand aerofoil-replay into a kinematic terminal airspace generator modeling 50+ aircraft across realistic STAR arrivals, SID climbs, high-altitude en-route cruises, holding patterns, and VFR flights, emitting a rich, loopable DO-260B/DO-282B Beast fixture (datasets/fixtures/terminal_airspace_hub.beast).

task.title: Long-run flight kinematic trajectory and continuous tracking regression test suite
task.description: Implement integration test suite verifying that 50+ aircraft undergoing continuous climbs, descents, turns, and velocity changes maintain smooth track continuity, without position jumps, heading discontinuities, or CPR coordinate decode errors over multi-minute simulation runs.

task.title: Live Beast network feed capture and public dataset downloader script
task.description: Add capture CLI subcommand and server option to record live Beast/AVR streams directly to compressed timestamped fixtures, alongside scripts/download-datasets.sh support for curating public ADS-B receiver traces (ADSBexchange, OpenSky).

task.title: Full-pipeline server SSE and WebSocket streaming integration tests
task.description: Build end-to-end integration tests in aerofoil-server verifying end-to-end stream ingestion from Beast/AVR inputs through the tracker to SSE (/api/stream) and WebSocket clients, asserting event delivery, client backpressure, and reconnection recovery.

task.title: Headless browser end-to-end automation test suite with Playwright
task.description: Implement headless browser E2E test suite in apps/web using Playwright: verify clean Leaflet 2.0 and MapLibre GL 3D canvas mounting without WebGL/JS console errors, test 2D/3D mode toggling, CARTO/OSM basemap rendering, layer drawer controls, and aircraft marker click inspection.

task.title: RTL-SDR DSP demodulation pipeline and direct hardware receiver interface
task.description: Bridge the aerofoil-sdr PPM (1090 MHz) and FSK (978 MHz) demodulators to a direct hardware receiver interface (RTL-SDR USB and rtl_tcp network streaming), enabling aerofoil-cli and aerofoil-server to demodulate live RF down to decoded ADS-B frames without external dump1090/readsb dependencies.

task.title: Raw IQ modulated sample capture and RF replay engine
task.description: Add support for capturing raw received RF IQ baseband samples (.cu8 unsigned 8-bit and .cf32 float32) directly to disk from the SDR receiver, along with an RF replay mode in aerofoil-replay to feed raw IQ samples into the aerofoil-sdr demodulator for DSP testing.
